en: While a task is running, typing a follow-up makes the main composer button send guidance or queue the message. A separate stop button remains available.
Follow-up instructions retain the original objective and unfinished requirements. Codex guidance stays in the active turn, and later messages resume the same native thread.
zh: 任务运行中输入补充内容后，输入框主按钮改为发送引导或排队，停止按钮单独保留，避免把发送补充误操作为停止。
追加要求沿用原目标和未完成事项；Codex实时引导在当前轮次中接收，后续消息继续使用原生会话。
